verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm https://docs.perplexity.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an agent-oriented index of the API docs. Docs pages are served as raw markdown (.md) and explicitly point agents to the llms.txt index, and a machine-readable openapi.json is also served. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, and no independent or community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs.
